channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: War on Iran: Is escalation more likely than a deal?
item.description: Former Iranian and US diplomats agree that the war on Iran is likely to get worse in the coming weeks.

item.title: Air strike in Sudan kills UN aid truck driver: WFP
item.description: Trucks were 'clearly marked as humanitarian vehicles', UN agency says.

item.title: Iran tells US: there is ‘no military solution’ to end the war
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says the era of “wasting time and dictating demands is over’.

item.title: Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis
item.description: The Yemeni president's announcement comes amid an exchange of strikes between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition.

item.title: Australia investigating Flydubai co-pilot's links to country
item.description: State police and the country's security agency are looking into the co-pilot, who attempted to take control of a Flydubai plane travelling to Israel.

item.title: US father and son arrested after 'gas station heroin' deaths
item.description: They are accused of selling at least one student derivatives of kratom, often called "gas station heroin" in the US.
